description: Implementation of an AWS Transcribe Speech-to-Text service using WebSocket streaming, supporting multiple languages and real-time transcription.

classes.name: AWSTranscribeSTTService
classes.description: A service class implementing real-time speech-to-text using AWS Transcribe over WebSocket, supporting multiple languages and handling transcription results.

methods.name: str get_service_encoding(self, encoding: str)
methods.description: Converts internal encoding format to AWS Transcribe compatible encoding.

methods.name: start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Initializes the service and establishes a WebSocket connection.

methods.name: stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops the service and disconnects from AWS Transcribe.

methods.name: cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Cancels the service and disconnects from AWS Transcribe.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_stt(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Processes and sends audio data to AWS Transcribe, yielding transcription frames or errors.

methods.name: _connect(self)
methods.description: Establishes the WebSocket connection with AWS Transcribe.

methods.name: _disconnect(self)
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and cleans up.

methods.name: _connect_websocket(self)
methods.description: Creates WebSocket connection to AWS Transcribe with appropriate headers and URL.

methods.name: str|None language_to_service_language(self, language: Language)
methods.description: Maps internal language enum to AWS Transcribe language code.

methods.name: _handle_transcription( self, transcript: str, is_final: bool, language: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Handles processed transcription results; currently a placeholder.

methods.name: _get_websocket(self)
methods.description: Returns the active WebSocket connection or raises an exception if not connected.

methods.name: _receive_messages(self)
methods.description: Continuously receives and processes messages from AWS Transcribe WebSocket.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, api_key: Optional[str] = None, aws_access_key_id: Optional[str] = None, aws_session_token: Optional[str] = None, region: Optional[str] = None, sample_rate: int = 16000, language: Language = Language.EN, **kwargs, )

ctags.signature: ( self, *, api_key: Optional[str] = None, aws_access_key_id: Optional[str] = None, aws_session_token: Optional[str] = None, region: Optional[str] = None, sample_rate: int = 16000, language: Language = Language.EN, **kwargs, )

ctags.signature: ( self, transcript: str, is_final: bool, language: Optional[str] = None )
